comparison.objective: Lower a ratchet-supported load through an intermediate hold and restart; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transfer, crank control, pawl release, regrasping, and contact-supported holding versus setscrew/collar adjustment and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Load must hold on an intermediate tooth before final lowering; candidate must stop a carriage twice without bottoming or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve energy-bearing mechanisms and guarded restart, but one tests ratchet load handling while the other tests adjustment of dissipative response.
